title: Beginner Football IQ
description: Establish a strong foundation in tactical shapes, learning how teams defend as a unit, press high, and transition quickly.

title: Pressing Systems & Traps
description: Understand how modern defensive systems choke passing lanes, orchestrate coordinated presses, and construct sidelines/midfield traps.

title: Positional Play (Juego de Posición)
description: Learn the art of spatial dominance: creating midfield numerical overloads, utilizing a False 9, and running off-ball combinations.

title: Modern Attacking Football
description: Master attacking movements: cutting inside with inverted wingers, third man run mechanics, and vertical counter-attack triggers.

title: Defensive Organization
description: Master off-ball stability: maintaining vertical/horizontal compactness, sliding in zonal blocks, and triggering midblock traps.

title: Guardiola Principles
description: Explore the signature Pep Guardiola tactical concepts: strikerless False 9 setups, inverted fullbacks creating overloads, and third man runs.

title: Klopp Principles (Gegenpressing)
description: Delve into Jürgen Klopp's heavy metal football: high-intensity pressing, trapping, and rapid transitions.
